question: Which remaining parts of this bundled request should OpenClaw core own now, and should maintainers split them into separate follow-up issues?
rationale: Several requested behaviors already exist on current main, while the remaining docs, config-diff, and audit semantics cross stable setup, auth, update, and audit surfaces that require owner/product direction before implementation.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Create or designate separate issues for systemd SecretRef deployment docs, update config-diff reporting, and unified audit semantics; keep this issue as planning context until that split is complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella planning
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad maintainer planning item, accepting that it is not suitable for one ClawSweeper repair PR.

options.title: Close after explicit scope decision
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining docs and audit requests are already covered or not planned after the narrower related PR is resolved.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Create or designate separate issues for systemd SecretRef deployment docs, update config-diff reporting, and unified audit semantics; keep this issue as planning context until that split is complete.
